rules.rationale: Every product module has exactly one semantic owner.
Every component dependency is explicit; absence forbids the edge.
The component graph must remain acyclic.
Cross-component imports use the owning component's declared API.

The DSL facade exposes declared contract types. Four pre-validation operations preserve raw string-keyed attribute dictionaries at exact reviewed positions; constraint facts remain closed types. parse_properties returns an open map for arbitrary user keys. element_aliases returns a fresh alias-to-canonical string map from the owned built-in and extension registry; its keys are vocabulary data, not fixed record fields.

The domain facade exposes declared generator classes through a typed iterator, never an untyped registry dictionary. DemographicSampler.provenance_descriptor returns a fresh snapshot of its recorded normalized resource-path to provenance-digest string map; paths are data keys, not fixed record fields. Converter extension APIs receive and may return native Python values; arbitrary input acceptance and method-local validation preserve substitutability, extension results and native errors. Only the enumerated direct object/object-or-None positions admit opacity; existing precise specialized outputs and fixed control signatures remain required. Demographic sampling owns dataset-keyed weight distributions and accepts a non-owning metadata mapping of string keys to string-or-None group references. The three enumerated weight accessors return fresh dictionaries keyed by age interval, condition name, or SexKey; these are maps, not fixed records. This allowance does not validate raw CSV producers or accept malformed-row type mismatches. Transaction generation accepts an optional opaque account hint. Its existing truthiness and CurrencyAccount capability check selects account currency; non-account or falsey inputs retain generated-currency fallback. Only the enumerated direct bank_account input admits opacity; GeneratedTransactionData and other control/output signatures remain precise.

Fixed requests and execution controls stay typed. Captures, descriptor properties, the client registry, native Python state and copy memo use exact reviewed positions. Runtime owns native registries keyed by declared client IDs and by statement/source identities. Their exact RegisteredClient and tuple-to-count mapping contracts preserve mutable registry identity without fixed-field wrappers.

allowed_positions.annotation: dict[tuple[str | None, str | None], int] | None

rules.rationale: The IO facade keeps fixed controls typed; smoke-export rows/options and connection profiles remain open payloads at reviewed positions. WeightedEntityDataSource returns a selected native string-valued row keyed by input CSV headers; headers are data keys, and row aliasing remains observable.
The Authoring facade exposes typed application requests and results rather than implementation modules.
The resource facade exposes typed packaged-resource access rather than string-based package discovery.
Public behavior uses explicit types and avoids reflective escape hatches.
Only these DSL/runtime compatibility adapters may forward dynamic attributes; every other getattr remains forbidden.
Dynamic execution is isolated in scripting's expression and plugin owners.
No production module cycles, including type-only imports; a green component graph is insufficient.
Intent and validation facts must remain runtime-free; bounded execution is an adapter concern.
Intent cannot open sources or construct clients.
Runtime reflection belongs in a capability adapter; projections render supplied facts.
Task orchestration delegates IO operations; it never imports concrete clients, even for typing.
